newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pier 1 Imports buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pier 1 Imports buy repeated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc repeated its buy recommendation for Pier 1 Imports Inc.
-- Analyst Alan Rifkin said he was "comfortable" with his current fourth quarter earnings estimate of $0.22 per share and his 1996 estimate of $1.01.
-- The retailer earned $0.17 in the fourth quarter last year and $0.85 per share for the whole year.
-- He tied his estimates, which he said were high, to the company's remodelling and merchandising strategy as well as its national television advertising campaign.
-- "I think the stock is real, real cheap," he said. "From a valuation perspective, it's trading near the lowest valuation of the last three years. So I think it is a compelling buying opportunity."
-- Pier 1 shares traded up 1-5/8 at 14-1/8. --Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787
